discriminate_from.graphite_layered: an fcc packing of C60 molecules with alkali metals in the octahedral and tetrahedral voids -- not an extended sp2 sheet
discriminate_from.organic_polymer: crystalline molecular solid, not a polymer

notes: Proposed while annotating chunk 001: the C host contains Rb3C60 and K3C60, which share no structural feature with graphite.
The alkali content is a filling level setting the t1u band occupancy, not dilute doping.

discriminate_from.tetrahedrite: a different Cu-S sulfosalt framework with a distinct cubic cell and no Sb lone pair
discriminate_from.cu2gese3: Cu2SnS3 is the simple diamond-like ternary; colusite has a much larger cell and a transition-metal framework site
discriminate_from.stannite_kesterite: colusite is not a diamond-like superstructure

notes: Proposed while annotating chunk 002: Cu26V2Sn6S32 is the largest composition in the Cu-S-Sn host and has no taxonomy entry.
Cu content and the V/Nb framework site are the carrier-tuning variables.
